name: scdaw_export_stems
description: Renders consolidated Bar 1 Beat 1 audio stems across all tracks with multi-tap routing (post-fader, pre-fader, pre-fx), silence-tail trimming, and bundles stems, MIDI, and project into a ZIP archive.

loops.description: Number of loop repetitions to render (1-8, default 1)

tap.description: Tap routing: post-fader (default), pre-fader (raw track level), pre-fx (raw synth voice)

trimSilence.description: Whether to trim tail silence below -72dBFS threshold (default true)

bundleZip.description: Whether to package all stems into a single ZIP bundle (default true)

includeMidi.description: Whether to include Standard MIDI File (.mid) in bundle (default true)

includeProject.description: Whether to include native .scdaw.json project in bundle (default true)

saveToWorkspace.description: Whether to trigger browser download of the stems ZIP archive
